Second test build of **Voxira Client** for **Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric).

> ⚠️ Pre-release: not tested in game yet. Please report problems as an [issue](https://github.com/Real3rr0r303YT/voxira-client/issues).

## New
- **Module settings:** right click any module in the mod menu
- **AutoLog:** leave automatically on low health (optionally only when a hostile mob is near), when a player comes near, or when a player teleports to you. Every trigger is configurable.
- **Auto Reconnect:** countdown and reconnect button on the disconnect screen (never fires after AutoLog)
- **Custom Crosshair:** cross, dot, circle; color, size, gap, thickness, outline
- **Low Health Warning:** pulsing red screen edge
- **HUD:** Ping, Clock, Speed, Server Address
- **English in-game UI**

## Installation
1. Fabric Loader for **26.3** (or a CurseForge custom profile with Fabric)
2. [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) in the `mods` folder
3. `voxira-client-0.2.0.jar` in the `mods` folder

Your existing `config/voxira.json` is kept.
